cards.headline: The tape: a broad bid, 70% of energy names green
cards.body: SPX +1.85% · WTI -3.66% · Brent -4.21% · NatGas +4.40%. 70% of 67 energy names are green — a broad bid. Grid, Storage & Electrification is doing the heavy lifting at +7.08%.

cards.headline: Grid, Storage & Electrification leads, Oil & Gas Majors lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Grid, Storage & Electrification at +7.08%; weakest is Oil & Gas Majors at -0.65%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.

cards.headline: BE is the standout at +13.67%
cards.body: Leaders: BE +13.67%, VRT +9.22%, NRG +9.01%, PWR +6.69%, GEV +6.61%. Laggards: ARRY -6.15%, FSLR -2.79%, EQNR -2.19%, FLNC -1.80%.
cards.watch: Hot means attention, not direction — watch whether the leaders hold the bid or fade into the next session.
